diff_summary: Added per-test in-memory token revocation stubs for auth characterization tests and stubbed expired-revocation cleanup in the login-throttle client.

verification.command: env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend DATABASE_URL=postgresql://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable MONGODB_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:1 .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_api.py -k 'auth_characterization or cookie_auth' backend/tests/test_login_throttle.py && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/tests/test_api.py backend/tests/test_login_throttle.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/tests/test_api.py backend/tests/test_login_throttle.py
